columns.name: lap
columns.description: Lap counter (0-based, as reported by AC).

columns.name: steer
columns.description: Steering wheel angle in degrees (CarState.steer; AC exposes the normalized value only on a physics-controls struct, so the descriptive log carries degrees).

columns.name: gear
columns.description: Gear index as reported by CSP (-1 reverse, 0 neutral, 1+ forward).

columns.name: wheels_outside
columns.description: Number of wheels off the track surface (0-4).

columns.name: in_pit
columns.description: Car is in pit lane / pit transition.
